ideas: How and where you first met
What keeps the friendship going after all these years
A memory you both still laugh about

phrases.meaning: have known each other a long time

phrases.phrase: pick up where we left off

phrases.meaning: support someone when they need it

model: The friend I've known the longest is a guy called Minh, who I met on my very first day of primary school, so we go way back, about twenty years now. Apparently we were sitting at the same desk, which was right next to the window, and we hit it off straight away because we both loved drawing robots. Right now he's living in Da Nang and working as an architect, while I'm based in Ho Chi Minh City, so we don't see each other very often. A lot of my school friendships drifted apart once we went to different universities, but somehow ours didn't. I think it's partly because we're on the same wavelength about most things, and we've got a shared sense of humour, which is a bit childish, to be honest. We keep in touch mostly through voice messages, and whenever I visit Da Nang, we just pick up where we left off, as if no time has passed. The moment that really showed me what kind of friend he is happened a few years ago, when I lost my first job. He was the only person who called me every evening that week, and he even drove down at the weekend to cheer me up. He's someone who's always there for me, and I'd like to think I'm there for him too. I honestly can't imagine my life without him.
